```{r}
library(GSVA)
library(msigdbr)
library(edgeR)
```

```{r}
clinical_data <- read.csv("data/ucec_clinical.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na.strings = c("NA", ""))


rownames(clinical_data) <- clinical_data$sample_submitter_id
clinical_data <- clinical_data[!is.na(clinical_data$MSI_TMB),]
```

```{r}
counts <- as.matrix(read.csv("data/UCEC/count_gene_name.csv",
                             row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
```

```{r}
clinical_data$MSI_TMB <- factor(clinical_data$MSI_TMB,
                                levels = c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L"),
                                labels = c("MSI_H", "MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_L"))


common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(clinical_data))
counts <- counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
clinical_data <- clinical_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts, group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB)


keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(y, group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB, min.count = 10)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]


y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")


expr_matrix <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)


expr_matrix <- as.matrix(expr_matrix)
storage.mode(expr_matrix) <- "double"
expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[!duplicated(rownames(expr_matrix)), , drop = FALSE]


out_expr <- "data/prepared/ucec_expr_logCPM_TMM.csv"

if (!dir.exists(dirname(out_expr))) dir.create(dirname(out_expr), recursive = TRUE)
utils::write.csv(expr_matrix, out_expr, row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
expr_matrix <- read.csv(out_expr, 
                        row.names = 1, 
                        check.names = FALSE,    
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


expr_matrix <- as.matrix(expr_matrix)


colnames(expr_matrix) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(expr_matrix), fixed = FALSE)
```

```{r}
msig_h <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
pathways_list <- split(msig_h$gene_symbol, msig_h$gs_name)


pathways_list <- lapply(pathways_list, function(gs) intersect(gs, rownames(expr_matrix)))
pathways_list <- pathways_list[vapply(pathways_list, length, 1L) >= 10]
```

```{r}
genes_in_pathways <- unique(unlist(pathways_list))
expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[rownames(expr_matrix) %in% genes_in_pathways, , drop = FALSE]


gsva_params <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(
  expr = expr_matrix,
  geneSets = pathways_list
)


gsva_scores <- GSVA::gsva(gsva_params)


out_gsva <- "data/prepared/ucec_gsva_ssgsea_hallmark.csv"
utils::write.csv(gsva_scores, out_gsva, row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
gsva_scores <- read.csv(out_gsva, 
                        row.names = 1, 
                        check.names = FALSE,    
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


gsva_scores <- as.matrix(gsva_scores)


colnames(gsva_scores) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(expr_matrix), fixed = FALSE)
as.data.frame(gsva_scores)
```

```{r}
clinical_data <- clinical_data[colnames(gsva_scores),]
```

```{r}
library(limma)


samples <- intersect(colnames(gsva_scores), rownames(clinical_data))
gsva_scores <- gsva_scores[, samples, drop = FALSE]
clinical_data <- clinical_data[samples, , drop = FALSE]


design <- stats::model.matrix(~ 0 + clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
colnames(design) <- levels(clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
rownames(design) <- rownames(clinical_data)  



merged <- dplyr::left_join(clinical_data, as.data.frame(design), )


print(merged[, c("Sample_ID", "MSI_TMB", "MSI_H", "MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_L")])


fit <- limma::lmFit((gsva_scores), design)

contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(
  MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L,
  MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H = MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H,
  MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L,
  levels = design
)
fit2 <- limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2)
top_pathways <- limma::topTable(fit2, number = Inf, adjust = "BH")
```

```{r}
logfc_threshold <- 0.03
pval_column <- "adj.P.Val"
output_dir <- "data/DE_results/ucec"

comparison_cols <- c("MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L", "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L")


dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


write_directional_files <- function(df, groupA, groupB, output_dir) {
  
  up_in_A   <- df[df$logFC >  logfc_threshold & df$pval < 0.05, ]
  down_in_A <- df[df$logFC < -logfc_threshold & df$pval < 0.05, ]

  
  dir.create(file.path(output_dir, groupA, "upregulated"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(output_dir, groupA, "downregulated"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  
  utils::write.csv(up_in_A, file.path(output_dir, groupA, "upregulated", paste0("pathways_compared_to_", groupB, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  utils::write.csv(down_in_A, file.path(output_dir, groupA, "downregulated", paste0("pathways_compared_to_", groupB, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}


for (comp in comparison_cols) {
  comp_split <- strsplit(comp, "_vs_")[[1]]
  groupA <- comp_split[1]  
  groupB <- comp_split[2]  

  df <- data.frame(
    pathway = rownames(top_pathways),
    logFC = top_pathways[[comp]],
    pval = top_pathways[[pval_column]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  
  write_directional_files(df, groupA, groupB, output_dir)

  
  df$logFC <- -df$logFC
  write_directional_files(df, groupB, groupA, output_dir)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


pdf_out <- "data/DE_results/ucec_top_pathways_groupwise.pdf"


plot_df <- top_pathways %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
  select(pathway, MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H, MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L, MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L, adj.P.Val) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H, MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L, MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L),
    names_to = "comparison", values_to = "logFC"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("^MSI_H", comparison) ~ "MSI_H",
      grepl("^MSS_TMB_H", comparison) ~ "MSS_TMB_H"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05)


plot_df$comparison <- dplyr::recode(
  plot_df$comparison,
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H" = "MSS/TMB-H",
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L" = "MSS/TMB-L",
  "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L" = "MSS/TMB-L"
)


plot_df$comparison <- factor(plot_df$comparison, levels = c("MSS/TMB-L", "MSS/TMB-H"))


x_range <- range(plot_df$logFC, na.rm = TRUE)


sort_order <- plot_df %>%
  filter(group == "MSI_H", comparison == "MSS/TMB-L") %>%
  arrange(logFC) %>%
  pull(pathway)
sort_order_mss <- plot_df %>%
  filter(group == "MSS_TMB_H", comparison == "MSS/TMB-L") %>%
  arrange(logFC) %>%
  pull(pathway)

grDevices::pdf(pdf_out, width = 10, height = 10)

for (g in unique(plot_df$group)) {
  subdf <- plot_df %>% filter(group == g)

  
  if (g == "MSI_H") {
    subdf$pathway <- factor(subdf$pathway, levels = sort_order)
  }
  
  if (g == "MSS_TMB_H") {
    subdf$pathway <- factor(subdf$pathway, levels = sort_order_mss)
  }

  p <- ggplot(subdf, aes(x = pathway, y = logFC, fill = comparison)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.86), width = 0.85) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("MSS/TMB-L" = "steelblue", "MSS/TMB-H" = "firebrick")) +
    ylim(x_range[1], x_range[2]) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Pathway expression (GSVA) in ", g),
      x = "Pathway",
      y = "logFC vs other subtype",
      fill = "Comparison"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  print(p)
}

grDevices::dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
clinical_data <- read.csv("data/ucec_clinical.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na.strings = c("NA", ""))


rownames(clinical_data) <- clinical_data$sample_submitter_id
clinical_data <- clinical_data[!is.na(clinical_data$MSI_TMB),]
```

```{r}
counts <- as.matrix(read.csv("data/UCEC/count_gene_name.csv",
                             row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
```

```{r}
clinical_data$MSI_TMB <- factor(clinical_data$MSI_TMB,
                                levels = c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L"),
                                labels = c("MSI_H", "MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_L"))


common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(clinical_data))
counts <- counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
clinical_data <- clinical_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts, group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB)



keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(y, group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB, min.count = 10)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
```

```{r}
y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")


design <- stats::model.matrix(~0 + clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
colnames(design) <- levels(clinical_data$MSI_TMB)


y <- edgeR::estimateDisp(y, design, robust = TRUE)


fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(y, design, robust = TRUE)


contrasts <- list(
  MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H  = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H, levels = design),
  MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L  = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design),
  MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design)
)


results <- lapply(contrasts, function(ct) {
  qlf <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = ct)
  top <- edgeR::topTags(qlf, n = Inf)
  return(top$table)
})
```

```{r}
for (name in names(results)) {
  safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", name)
  write.csv(results[[name]],
            file = paste0("data/DE_results/ucec/", safe_name, ".csv"))
}
```

```{r}
res_dir <- "data/DE_results/ucec"
res_files <- list.files(res_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

for (file in res_files) {
  df <- read.csv(file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  
  
  df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(df, var = "Gene")
  
  
  df_filtered <- df %>%
    filter(FDR <= 0.05) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
    select(Gene, logFC)
  
  
  base <- gsub("\\.csv$", "", basename(file))
  out_file <- file.path(res_dir, paste0(base, "_sig_genes.csv"))
  write.csv(df_filtered, out_file, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(fs) 

res_dir <- "data/DE_results/ucec/"
res_files <- list.files(res_dir, pattern = "_sig_genes\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

for (file in res_files) {
  df <- read.csv(file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(df, var = "Gene")
  
  
  base <- gsub("_sig_genes\\.csv$", "", basename(file))
  
  
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(base, "_vs_"))
  if (length(parts) != 2) next
  
  group1 <- parts[1]
  group2 <- parts[2]
  
  
  df_up <- df %>% filter(logFC > 0) %>% arrange(desc(logFC)) %>% select(Gene, logFC)
  df_down <- df %>% filter(logFC < 0) %>% arrange(logFC) %>% select(Gene, logFC)
  
  
  up_dir_g1 <- file.path(res_dir, group1, "upregulated")
  down_dir_g1 <- file.path(res_dir, group1, "downregulated")
  up_dir_g2 <- file.path(res_dir, group2, "upregulated")
  down_dir_g2 <- file.path(res_dir, group2, "downregulated")
  fs::dir_create(c(up_dir_g1, down_dir_g1, up_dir_g2, down_dir_g2))
  
  
  write.csv(df_up,   file.path(up_dir_g1,   paste0("compared_to_", group2, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(df_down, file.path(down_dir_g1, paste0("compared_to_", group2, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
  
  df_up_g2   <- df %>% filter(logFC < 0) %>% arrange(desc(abs(logFC))) %>% select(Gene, logFC = -logFC)
  df_down_g2 <- df %>% filter(logFC > 0) %>% arrange(abs(logFC)) %>% select(Gene, logFC = -logFC)
  
  write.csv(df_up_g2,   file.path(up_dir_g2,   paste0("compared_to_", group1, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(df_down_g2, file.path(down_dir_g2, paste0("compared_to_", group1, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

sel_pw <- c("HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING","HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS","HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT")


samples <- intersect(colnames(gsva_scores), rownames(clinical_data))
stopifnot(length(samples) > 0)
gsva_sel <- gsva_scores[sel_pw, samples, drop = FALSE]

plot_df <- as.data.frame(t(gsva_sel)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    tibble::tibble(sample = rownames(clinical_data), MSI_TMB = clinical_data$MSI_TMB),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sel_pw), names_to = "pathway", values_to = "score") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    MSI_TMB = factor(MSI_TMB, levels = c("MSI_H","MSS_TMB_H","MSS_TMB_L")),
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = sel_pw)
  )

pdf_violin <- "data/DE_results/gsva_violin_selected_pathways.pdf"
grDevices::pdf(pdf_violin, width = 10, height = 7)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = MSI_TMB, y = score, fill = MSI_TMB)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
  
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, fatten = 0, color = "black") +
  
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ pathway, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("MSI_H" = "#1f77b4", "MSS_TMB_H" = "#d62728", "MSS_TMB_L" = "#2ca02c")) +
  labs(title = "Per-sample GSVA scores by MSI group",
       x = "MSI/TMB group", y = "GSVA (ssGSEA) score", fill = "Group") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(1)  

grDevices::dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

sel_pw <- c("HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING","HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS","HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT")


samples <- intersect(colnames(gsva_scores), rownames(clinical_data))
anno <- data.frame(MSI_TMB = clinical_data[samples, "MSI_TMB", drop = TRUE])
rownames(anno) <- samples

mat <- gsva_scores[sel_pw, samples, drop = FALSE]


mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))


ord <- order(
  anno$MSI_TMB,
  colMeans(mat_z, na.rm = TRUE)  
)

mat_z <- mat_z[, ord, drop = FALSE]
anno_ord <- anno[ord, , drop = FALSE]


ann_colors <- list(
  MSI_TMB = c(MSI_H = "#1f77b4", MSS_TMB_H = "#d62728", MSS_TMB_L = "#2ca02c")
)


pdf_hm <- "data/DE_results/gsva_heatmap_selected_pathways_sorted.pdf"
grDevices::pdf(pdf_hm, width = 10, height = 2)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat_z,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(
    "#313695","#4575b4","#74add1","#abd9e9","#e0f3f8",
    "#ffffbf","#fee090","#fdae61","#f46d43","#d73027","#a50026"
  ))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 10,
  border_color = NA,
  annotation_col = anno_ord,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  main = "Selected pathways (row z-score), ordered within MSI groups"
)

grDevices::dev.off()
```
